items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I recorded a lot with Cozy when he was recording. And I used to write the arrangements... Cozy and I got a studio together.

ctx.x: Yeah, Cozy had a little band. He was playing in one of them dance schools. See, in them early days with them dance schools, if you got a dance school job, you had a job. So I sold my little arrangements to...
So he had a band, right?
